title: Gates Cambridge and Commonwealth Scholarships

Gates Cambridge Scholarship

The Gates Cambridge Scholarship funds postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge. It is open to citizens of any country outside the UK, so Nepalese students can apply. It covers PhD (full or part-time), MLitt and many one-year full-time postgraduate courses.

  • Covers: the full cost of study, including tuition, a maintenance allowance, airfare, visa costs and the Immigration Health Surcharge.
  • Maintenance: £22,000 for 12 months at the 2025/26 rate.
  • Length: PhD awards can run for up to four years.
  • Not eligible: undergraduate degrees, MBA, MASt and several other courses.
ℹ️
Confirm dates on the official siteFor an October 2027 start, published deadlines are 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027 for most applicants, depending on the course. Check gatescambridge.org for the exact date.

Commonwealth Master's Scholarships

Commonwealth Master's Scholarships fund one-year taught master's degrees in the UK for students from eligible Commonwealth countries. The award covers tuition, airfare and a monthly stipend of £1,712 (£2,000 for London-area universities).

⚠️
Nepal is not eligibleNepal is not on the eligible-countries list for Commonwealth Master's Scholarships, so Nepalese students cannot apply for this one. Students from some other countries can.

The 2027/28 round closed on 20 October 2026. Applications go through the Commission's online system and a national nominating body, not direct to the Commission.

How Competitive Are These Awards?

Gates Cambridge makes about 80 awards each year to applicants from around the world. It looks for academic excellence, leadership potential and a commitment to improving others' lives.

  1. Apply to Cambridge firstThe scholarship application is part of the university's graduate application.
  2. Build a strong profileHigh grades, research or work experience, and leadership evidence all count.
  3. Write with purposeShow how your work will help others, not only yourself.
  4. Plan a backupApply to other funded options and universities in parallel.

Funded Options That Are Open to Nepal

If Commonwealth Master's is closed to you, look at Gates Cambridge, Chevening and university scholarships. Many UK universities offer tuition discounts to international students, which reduce cost even when they do not fund living expenses.

University Awards Open to Nepalese Students

Big scholarships are rare, but university tuition discounts are common and several apply automatically. These reduce your cost, though they do not cover living expenses.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can Nepalese students apply for Gates Cambridge?
Yes. It is open to citizens of any country outside the UK, for eligible postgraduate courses.
Can Nepalese students apply for Commonwealth Master's Scholarships?
No. Nepal is not on the eligible-countries list for this program.
Does Gates Cambridge cover an MBA?
No. MBA and several other courses are not eligible.
